issues.description: Task 07 in the problem statement explicitly asks to output only the names of Gemeinden that meet the condition. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql) returns additional columns (einwohner_m, einwohner_w) in addition to name. This contradicts the instruction "Gib immer genau die geforderten Daten aus und nicht mehr." The mismatch will likely cause the automated checks (which verify selected columns) to fail and will confuse students about the exact expected output.
issues.suggested_fix: Align the solution with the problem statement by returning only the requested column. Change solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql to: SELECT name FROM Gemeinde WHERE einwohner_m > 75000 OR einwohner_w > 75000. Alternatively, if the intention was to include the population columns, update the problem statement to explicitly list those columns as required.
